name: Suzumiya Haru** no Oetsu
source:
This is a gang bang violation adventure game novel based on "The Melancholy of Haruhi Suzumiya."

The computer research society president has been rejected by the wild child Haruhi and gets his members together to plan an attack on Haruhi.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE036054.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这是根据《凉宫春日的忧郁》改编的轮奸冒险游戏小说。

计算机研究会会长遭到野孩子春日的拒绝，并召集成员们策划对春日的攻击。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE036054.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
